ILLUSTRATIVE BLUEPRINT / 01Azure lakehouse pipeline

A design concept for moving raw data through bronze, silver, and gold layers. ADF ingests to ADLS Gen2, PySpark transforms in Databricks, and Delta Lake stores curated datasets.

ADF → ADLS Gen2 → Databricks / Delta Lake → Analytics

Engineering considerations: incremental ingestion, schema checks, idempotent writes, and quarantining invalid rows. This is a proposed architecture, not a claim of a completed personal project.

ILLUSTRATIVE BLUEPRINT / 02Analytics-ready warehouse

A design concept for transforming warehouse data into clearly defined business models using Snowflake and dbt, with Airflow coordinating dependencies.

Sources → Snowflake → dbt models & tests → Analytics

Engineering considerations: staging and mart layers, explicit model grain, uniqueness and relationship tests, freshness checks, and Git-based review. This is a proposed architecture, not a claim of a completed personal project.
